notes.title: [Demo Updates] Quality Update Part 1 is live
notes.content:
[b]Quality Update Part 1 for the Demo is Live![/b]

[h1]Tutorial Levels[/h1]
The tutorial levels are now available!
Players can gradually master the core combat mechanics and rules through three concise tutorial levels, learning the game's foundational gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/03cf5490a8a57fff7f1946780774b0f9ed28395b.png[/img]

[h1]Talent Skill Update[/h1]
Each character has received new Talent Skills—more powerful but with stricter activation conditions. Use the character's cards strategically to charge these skills faster!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/856907acd1264d0c171eaebd47580bfe7548afcb.png[/img]

[h1]Card Art[/h1]
Spiced up the card art! All playable cards now feature updated thumbnails for better visual clarity.
Additionally, persistent effects requiring attention are now marked in the top-right corner of cards, ensuring quicker information access.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/5a0704ffbfb7fe54fd3abfe173494e201235b81e.png[/img]

Along with numerous fixes and reworks for cards and buff effects—dive in and explore!
[b]Part 2 of the update[/b], launching during the June 9 Steam Next Fest, will introduce new enemies and character card slots!

notes.title: 【Demo更新】试玩版本修复和更新
notes.content:
Update Details:

1.Updated the event selector - players can now preview choices for the next special node.

2.Improved the drag indicator for party positioning to make dragging more precise.

3.Fixed some card attribute issues.

4.Fixed mismatches between certain descriptions and actual effects.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Demo Launch and Demo Usability Improvements
notes.content:
Welcome to the plat demo version of The Triminals!

Today’s playability update includes the following improvements:

Character combat previews now correctly update when enemies gain effects like Frustration.

Added anti-misclick protection to the End Turn button.

The energy display now shows a preview of card costs when played.


Send your feedbacks and question at discord: https://discord.gg/2XDqnZvB
